view: Close, slightly-low 3/4 front view at throat level; collar worn open with the single stand button undone, the two ROUNDED front ends of the collar band parted at the closure and dominating the center of frame; point-collar leaves framing them above, front placket running below.

geometry.collar_type: Two-piece turned-down point collar sewn onto a separate collar stand (band).
geometry.featured_shape: The FRONT END of the collar stand at the closure is cut ROUND: one continuous convex curve sweeping from the band's top edge around to the neck seam. No corner, no straight vertical front edge, no flat segment anywhere on the end. In the tech pack this curve is traced in red around the fastened stand button; both band ends share the same rounded shape.
geometry.buttons: Exactly ONE button on the collar stand (10 mm, centered on the band height, horizontal buttonhole on the opposing rounded end) and exactly ONE placket button visible below in the crop — two buttons total in frame.
geometry.stitching: Single edge topstitch row 5 mm inside the collar-leaf edges and along both long edges of the stand (drawn as dashed lines); the same 5 mm topstitch follows the rounded contour of each band end; neck seam joins stand to body.
geometry.placket: Standard sewn front button placket, about 3.5 cm wide, with TWO parallel vertical topstitch rows and one visible placket button.
geometry.fabric_in_blueprint: Plain white; red is a highlight/construction marker only, never a fabric color.

ratios: Stand height (3.5 cm) is about three and a half stand-button diameters (10 mm button).
Round-end curve radius is about half the band height (1.8 cm vs 3.5 cm), so the curve occupies the entire front edge of the band with no flat remainder.
Collar point length is about twice the stand height (7.5 cm vs 3.5 cm).
Exactly two buttons in frame: one stand button plus one placket button; edge topstitch sits at roughly one-seventh of the band height from each edge.
locked_features: Both front ends of the collar stand are ROUND — a continuous convex curve; there is NO squared corner and NO straight vertical front edge (stated both ways).
Exactly ONE stand button — never two stacked buttons; standard band height, never the extra-tall 5 cm band.
Both ends match: symmetric rounding, never one square end and one round end.
Two-piece collar: turned-down point collar leaves on a separate stand; worn open, no tie, plain white poplin.
Edge topstitching 5 mm from all collar and stand edges, following the round end contour; placket carries TWO parallel vertical topstitch rows and a visible button.
The blueprint's red curve and red button are highlight markers of the featured construction — rendered as white-fabric geometry; no red, no annotation text, arrows, or numerals may appear.
